title.suggested: Tom Allen picks Sullivan in expert predictions for New Orleans fights

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted a Chicago Inter Ocean canvass of experts on the September 1892 New Orleans fights. Tom Allen picked Sullivan over Corbett in 20 to 30 rounds.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, August 21, 1892. Dateline Chicago, August 18; canvass by the Chicago Inter Ocean.

facts.fact: Asked by the Inter Ocean to predict the September 1892 New Orleans fights, Allen, 'ex-heavy-weight champion', picked Sullivan to beat Corbett in 20 to 30 rounds, McAuliffe in 25 and Dixon in 10
Allen, called the heavy-weight champion, quoted betting odds on the New Orleans fights of 7 to 4 on Sullivan and 5 to 4 on McAuliffe
